title: Export trace
fullText: The complete trace holds everything the run stored: input, prompts, outputs, tool calls, memory and configuration.
fullWarning: Only pass it on if it contains nothing confidential.
sanitizedText: The sanitized trace replaces sensitive parts with placeholders like [EMAIL_1]. Equal values get the same placeholder, so the flow stays understandable.
alwaysSecrets: Always replaced when recognized: API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys.
personalDataText: E-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs, card numbers and IP addresses.
contentsText: Inputs, prompts, outputs, tool data and memory are replaced by their length. What remains is flow, status, models, times and tokens.
kept: Structure, status, times, models, tokens and cost stay unchanged.
noGuarantee: Detection works with patterns and is not guaranteed to find everything, for example no names or addresses. Look at the file before you pass it on.
copyOnly: Only the downloaded copy is sanitized; the stored run stays unchanged.
importedSanitized: This trace was exported sanitized. Replaced: {{summary}}.
